review.method: Ordered candidate sweep of all polished turns; expanded full-turn context at selected decisions; supplementary numeric-clock/spatial sweep; focused semantic review; deterministic provenance checks.
review.limitation: Not an independent exhaustive semantic audit of every turn. Recall not measured. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: One current day from sunrise to sunset, with a previous-evening scouting flashback. Study and short rests overlap; no exact total-hour reconstruction.
issues: Rest conventions are explicit assumptions; a long rest does not automatically equal a new calendar date.
Previous-evening retcon is outside the current May 19 day; may need separate retrospective coverage if future YAML semantics include flashbacks.
Rooftop ritual was proposed, not completed; later rests overlap other activity.
Room dimensions and map gestures are inconsistent/imprecise; no metric floor plan or coordinate assignment is attempted.
Upper ritual-room anvil and lower magical forge remain distinct. Sibyl temple here is not the similarly named Tollen building.

notes: Local place IDs are session-scoped. A vault link is an identity match, not proof of a visit.
Routes express topology and direction; geometry remains null. A place mentioned in a vision is not physical presence.
Visit markers do not assign every transcript line or every speaker to a place. No NPC whereabouts are automatically published.
parentRelation distinguishes containment, adjacency, approach, and inferred shared base; inspect its evidence before aggregating presence.
